FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 395
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Andy Whitt
Tourism
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/03/2026
House Bill 395 as introduced would further provide for the term "cost of merchandise" for the
make-up of liquor sold at wholesale by the Alabama Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Board.
This bill would not directly affect state or local funding.
